displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 8 red flashes
meaning: The flame was lost five times (four recycles) during the heating cycle. The furnace locks out for one hour and then restarts.
diySteps: Write down the 8 red flashes. The one-hour restart is not a repair
Technician: check gas pressure, the flame sensor and the gas valve
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the burners light and then go out until 8 red flashes appear.
